_comment: Canonical pins for third-party sources vendored by more than one First Motive repo. A consumer renders this to .fm/external-pins.json and points its own manifest (external.repos, pyproject, Dockerfile) at these commits. Re-pin here, never in a consumer. Each version is an exact commit — no branch names, no floating tags.

_fm_render.origin: rendered by the First Motive render plane — edit the upstream source, not this file

lerobot.note: No release tag upstream yet; re-pin with git ls-remote.

mujoco_ros2_control.note: Matches the rosdistro humble release the container's apt binary is built from.

openarm_description.note: A real ament_cmake package; must be built for package:// to resolve.

openarm_ros2.note: Hardware plugin, bringup, and bimanual MoveIt config. Humble is the target.

so_arm.note: SO101 flat URDF plus the official MJCF; file-vendored, not a ROS package.

unitree_ros.note: G1 description (flat URDF + meshes). No upstream tags exist.

unitree_ros2.note: Unitree DDS message packages; unitree_hg carries LowCmd/MotorCmd.
